ValidationRule.description: If the Task is assigned to the Compliance Queue, the user changing the status to 'Approved' or 'Complete' must be a member of the Compliance Queue.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(Status), OR( ISPICKVAL(Status, "Completed"), ISPICKVAL(Status, "Approved") ), AND( NOT ($Permission.Compliance_Task_Approval ), Owner:Queue.DeveloperName = 'Compliance') )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This task is Assigned to the Compliance Queue. You can only set the Task status to 'Approved' or 'Complete' if you are a member of the Compliance Queue.
